entries.text: 断层两侧接触面的摩擦能让局部暂时卡住，远处却仍在受力。坚硬岩石也能产生很小的弹性形变，把能量储存在形变中。标记线和能量条把这件事放大给你看；真实积累可能很慢，不能据此倒数地震。

entries.text: 本模型的驱动力越过静摩擦门槛后，断层开始滑移。附近岩石部分回弹，弹性储能减少，一部分能量以地震波传播。两块岩石已有相对错位，所以回弹不是把断层两侧退回最初位置。

entries.text: When this model crosses its static-friction threshold, the fault slips. Nearby rock partly rebounds, reducing stored elastic energy; some energy travels as seismic waves. The blocks remain offset, so rebound does not restore their original positions.

segments.spokenText: The focus is where rupture starts; the epicenter is its vertical surface projection. Changing the start changes the projection and paths to observation points. Rupture can spread along a fault, but this model does not solve finite rupture propagation.

entries.text: P 波传来时，邻近岩石沿传播方向交替压缩、伸展，恢复力把扰动继续传给下一处。跟着黄点看：它先向一边、再向另一边，最后回到原位；波前仍在向外走。

entries.text: In a P wave, nearby rock alternately compresses and stretches along the propagation direction. Restoring forces pass the disturbance onward. The yellow point moves one way, then back, returning to its origin while the front travels outward.

entries.text: S 波让邻近岩石沿垂直于传播方向的方向往复剪切。它传播较慢，但不是因为要等 P 波结束才出发。对照同一个观测点的到时：路程相同，速度不同，所以先后到达。

entries.text: An S wave produces back-and-forth shear perpendicular to its propagation direction. It is slower, not waiting for P to finish before starting. At the same observation point, equal path lengths and different speeds give different arrival times.

entries.text: 颜色表示两种波前；地下黄点和地表黄点表示岩石的局部运动，不是移动的能量球。先单看 P 或 S 的运动方向，再一起看它们的到时差。只有波经过的地方才在这次脉冲中振动。

entries.text: Colors show two wavefronts. Underground and surface yellow points represent local rock motion, not travelling energy balls. Inspect P or S motion first, then compare arrival times. A point moves during this pulse only as a wave passes it.
